lines.text: Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat became king of Judah at thirty-two and reigned in Jerusalem eight years.
Jehoram did evil like the house of Jeroboam, yet the LORD would not destroy Judah because of His promised lamp.
Edom rebelled against Judah and appointed its own king, and Jehoram attacked by night at Zair.
Jehoram was buried in the City of David, and Ahaziah became king; his mother Athaliah was Ben-hadad's granddaughter.

wrong_details.true: the granddaughter of Omri king of Israel

lines.text: Ahaziah went with Joram to fight Hazael at Ramoth-gilead, and Ahaziah later visited the wounded Joram in Jezreel.
